references.text: The prophet Isaiah describes the suffering and sacrifice of the one who was to come as a parallel to Jesus' call to carry his cross.
Jesus repeats the message about carrying one's cross and following him, which underscores the importance of this teaching.
Luke gives a parallel account to Mark, where Jesus urges self-denial and taking up one's cross.
Jesus speaks about hating one's life in this world in order to keep it for eternal life, echoing the message of self-denial in Mark.
